outcome: detection of neonatal sepsis pathogens in maternal microbiological smears
cohort: This study included 948 premature or newborn infants with neonatal infection at a Level 1 perinatal center from 2014 to 2019.
finding: The sepsis-causing pathogen was successfully detected through prior analysis of a maternal smear in 7% of full-term infants and in 19% of premature infants.
